evidence: The frozen policy is shaped: task/tests/scoring.toml:1-11 assigns zero-mass gates, 0.6/0.2/0.2 dimension weights and a 0.05 functional floor; task/tests/tools/score.py:41-48 computes a weighted reward only after passing gates and exceeding the floor. The scorer bytes equal the frozen template. Functional has 80 independently weighted binary outcomes (total weight 45.25), Polish six binary outcomes, and Visual six five-anchor Likert outcomes. Functional prompt:5,9 preserves local failures and prohibits protocol-wide all-legs scoring; Polish prompt:22,36 and Visual prompt:16,45,52 likewise preserve independent usability/craft evidence. These are plausible structural sources of gradation, not measured reward discrimination. All 21 raw-index artifact SHA256 values matched. The indexed history/post/runtime reports explicitly identify scripted reference proof, and surface-results.json says visual_grade_measured=false. raw-evidence-index.json:2,42-43 expressly excludes configured-judge scores; no runtime-evidence.json exists for this run. Therefore neither actual partial-app reward spread nor its robustness is demonstrated for input ae1d6f45959dbff89eb8963973dd7cfd29f634674f246410819317a7a3fc57a0. The user-deferred actual-judge gap remains truthful and cannot become Pass from score arithmetic or prior-candidate runs.
counterexample: Source-level challenges, not executed fixtures: (1) a workspace with authored Run and shared Save/load but no history, restore/retry or races can pass the two basic gates; its missing advanced features have individual functional owners, so there is no evident structural reason to erase its unrelated execution/usability results. (2) a conforming native-looking implementation using accessible menus, standard editor Escape/Tab behavior, a server-rendered library and static last-good rollback should remain eligible: gates accept server-rendered readback and purposeful control matching, while Polish/Visual explicitly accept native controls and conventional simple layouts. Whether the configured judge actually preserves those distinctions is unmeasured.
suggested_fix: Keep this deferred measurement gap visible; when actual-judge runs are authorized, grade the same frozen candidate against several controlled partial implementations and a conforming alternative, retain raw per-criterion and final rewards, and add hash-bound runtime evidence. No shared scoring-policy edit is justified by this review.
